verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents Phoenix Intelligence, a built-in AI agent that inspects traces, iterates prompts, and runs experiments, which directly delivers in-product AI-generated investigation of the user's data. Its LLM-as-a-judge evaluations also return natural-language explanations by default, adding AI-generated reasoning over traces and datasets. The external MCP endpoint is not credited because it runs outside the product. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of what insights and suggestions Phoenix Intelligence produces and how they surface in the UI, explicit evidence of proactive suggestions, independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent.
